title.value: List a broken iPad for sale with optimal pricing

introduction.value: A user had ChatGPT Agent create a listing for a cracked-screen iPad from two photos and shipping details, researching similar listings for price and starting bid; it sold for $60.

method.value: After deciding the cracked iPad was not worth repairing, the user gave ChatGPT Agent a prompt with FedEx Ground shipping instructions plus two images, including the Settings screen showing the model and serial number. They told it to look up similar listings and choose an optimal price and starting bid, and the agent created the sale listing; the user says they sometimes still have to help Agent along.

outcome.value: The listing worked well enough that the user sold the damaged iPad for $60 instead of eventually throwing it away. They also said Agent usually gets about 90% of the job done, not all of it.

notes.value: The most copyable detail was giving the agent shipping constraints up front and a photo of the device’s Settings screen with identifying info.

List a broken iPad for sale with optimal pricing
A user had ChatGPT Agent create a listing for a cracked-screen iPad from two photos and shipping details, researching similar listings for price and starting bid; it sold for $60.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
After deciding the cracked iPad was not worth repairing, the user gave ChatGPT Agent a prompt with FedEx Ground shipping instructions plus two images, including the Settings screen showing the model and serial number. They told it to look up similar listings and choose an optimal price and starting bid, and the agent created the sale listing; the user says they sometimes still have to help Agent along.
How it went
The listing worked well enough that the user sold the damaged iPad for $60 instead of eventually throwing it away. They also said Agent usually gets about 90% of the job done, not all of it.
Worth knowing
The most copyable detail was giving the agent shipping constraints up front and a photo of the device’s Settings screen with identifying info.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
I want to sell my [item, e.g. iPad with a cracked screen] and I am attaching [number] photos plus these details: [condition, accessories, shipping location and method]. Research similar sold and active listings on [marketplace, e.g. eBay], then draft a complete listing with a title, honest description, suggested starting price or bid, and shipping settings. Show me the finished draft and pause before you publish anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPTPro/comments/1mp2qbr/whats-the-most-surprising-thing-youve-done-with
